images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original 1994 Forever game landing background, landscape 3:2.
Reference image 1: approved Retro Solo scene defines the same rainy midnight arcade street, dark sheltered brick/awning at left, warm open arcade at right, cyan/magenta neon, wet pavement and distant city. Preserve that recognizable place, palette and crisp pixel-cluster rendering.
Reference image 2: approved retro-craft actor defines the ivory wedge-shaped body, orange/red edge stripes, dark blue/cyan cockpit, swept side wings and twin dark engine shapes. Use this original actor identity, not a commercial spacecraft.
Style: deliberate 16-bit pixel clusters and stepped edges, clean limited palette, no fine photographic grain or blur. Landscape with leftmost45% quiet near-black navy brick and awning for menu text. Place complete actor silhouettes in the right half with good separation from the background. Keep warm storefront windows, visible neon tubes, a small canopy lamp and a reflective pavement patch for later subtle scene animation.
No lettering, words, numbers, logos, labels, embedded UI, borders or watermark. No people, guns, missiles or explosions. Welcoming nostalgic arcade atmosphere. Opaque full artwork.
Mode composition: VERSUS. Two small full-size-in-scene retro arcade craft rest on TWO SEPARATE low launch/display platforms on the sheltered arcade forecourt, their pointed noses facing inward toward one another in friendly rivalry. One has cyan cockpit glow, the other warm magenta cockpit glow; both preserve the reference's ivory and orange silhouette. Position one around x60%,y72% and the other x82%,y67%. Show both complete wing spans and the gap between separate platforms; they must read as two opposing actors, not identical scenery. Keep the rainy arcade entrance and city depth visible behind them.

Follow-up correction:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: this generated Retro Versus scene.
Change only the TWO arcade craft and their immediate plinth perspective so their pointed noses face INWARD toward one another in three-quarter side view: left craft nose points diagonally right, right craft nose points diagonally left. Their long axes must clearly oppose one another. Retain separate cyan and magenta platforms, ivory/orange wings and blue/magenta cockpit identity. Do not simply recolor or leave both craft facing forward/up.
Preserve the entire rainy arcade street, dark left45% menu area, neon tubes, warm storefront, wet reflections, crisp pixel style and image framing exactly. Both complete silhouettes stay in the right half, with ample open gap between their noses, no touching/overlap.
No text, words, logos, embedded controls or added objects. Opaque full-frame landscape.
